set.body: Visual gallery signoff found that Breaks.default uses equal endpoint interpolation, producing correct but awkward labels for ordinary domains (for example 0, 7.75, 15.5, 23.25, 31 and -0.25, 0.0625, ...). Add deterministic JVM/JS-identical pretty breaks using 1/2/5-style steps while retaining Breaks.count for callers that require exact counts. Acceptance: representative positive, signed, tiny, large, and degenerate ranges; labels remain platform-identical; DesignGraphics default axes use readable ticks.
set.title: Graphics: add pretty continuous break generation
